'variants' paths are where the files are served: the upload package copies batches/2026-10-b/images/ to chapter3realty/images/buyers/ (upload.json images.to = chapter3realty/images/buyers). photos.title: Cherry Grove from the air, NOAA, January 2026
photos.what: Cherry Grove in North Myrtle Beach from the air on January 12, 2026: the beach and the Cherry Grove Pier at the left, homes along canals, and the salt marsh and its creeks behind them.
photos.caption: Cherry Grove from the air: the beach and part of the pier, canal homes and the salt marsh.
photos.alt: Cherry Grove in North Myrtle Beach from the air: the beach and part of a fishing pier at the left, rows of homes on canals, and a wide salt marsh with winding creeks
photos.author: NOAA National Geodetic Survey
photos.credit: Photo: NOAA National Geodetic Survey, public domain.
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: NOAA National Geodetic Survey (NGS), Remote Sensing Division, Emergency Response Imagery, 2026 pre-event coastal collection, East Coast group EC2601a. Flown 2026-01-12: the exterior orientation file raw/0122026_RGB_2_Oblique_EO.txt (day 012 of 2026) is the only flight file with frames within 6 km of the community, and the frame names carry 011226 (frames 185092 to 185108, about 16:45 UTC, about 2,300 m up). The group was posted 2026-03-19. Downloaded from the public S3 bucket noaa-eri-pds; the exact files are in source_files.
photos.license_note: 17 U.S.C. 105(a): "Copyright protection under this title is not available for any work of the United States Government". NOAA's terms on the Registry of Open Data (https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-eri/): "NOAA data disseminated through NODD are open to the public and can be used as desired." ... "NOAA requests attribution for the use or dissemination of unaltered NOAA data. However, it is not permissible to state or imply endorsement by or affiliation with NOAA. If you modify NOAA data, you may not state or imply that it is original, unaltered NOAA data." The NOAA InPort record for the NGS coastal imagery (item 67562) gives "Data access constraints: None" and says the missions "were conducted by NOAA's National Geodetic Survey, Remote Sensing Division". So: credit NOAA, say what Chapter3 changed (changes), never suggest NOAA endorses Chapter3. Read 2026-10-11.

photos.title: The Farm at Carolina Forest, NAIP aerial, April 2023
photos.what: The Farm at Carolina Forest from above on April 10, 2023, with its outline and six labels: the entrance on Carolina Forest Boulevard at the bottom, the activity center and the large pool near it, the townhomes of The Orchards on the east side, the small pool in the north part and the Planters Point condominiums in the north-east part. Curving streets of houses wind around ponds and strips of woods.
photos.caption: The Farm at Carolina Forest from above. The orange line is the edge of the neighborhood.
photos.alt: The Farm at Carolina Forest from above, its edge drawn in orange: curving streets of houses around ponds and woods, labelled with the entrance, the activity center, the large pool, The Orchards, the small pool and Planters Point
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm, flown 2023-04-10 (the date in the tile names m_3307809_se_17_060_20230410 and m_3307810_sw_17_060_20230410; ledger row 84). Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023); the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: The USGS service page says The National Map offers "free downloads of public domain, NAIP compressed orthoimagery". The USDA Farm Service Agency policy page says "Most information presented on the FSA Web site is considered public domain information. Public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, but use of appropriate byline/photo/image credits is requested." Planetary Computer's NAIP collection links the same FSA page as its license, titled "Public Domain". Read 2026-10-11 (batch 2026-10-a records); same source and terms.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Outline and labels by Chapter3 Realty.
